name: pixel-agents
description: Pixel art office where your Claude Code agents come to life as animated characters

commands.title: Pixel Agents: Export Layout as Default

scripts.build:webview: cd webview-ui && npx vite build --outDir ../dist/web && cd .. && cp dist/webview/assets/asset-index.json dist/web/assets/ 2>/dev/null; cp dist/webview/assets/furniture-catalog.json dist/web/assets/ 2>/dev/null
scripts.compile: npm run check-types && npm run lint && node esbuild.js && npm run build:webview
scripts.package: npm run check-types && npm run lint && node esbuild.js --production && npm run build:webview
scripts.lint: eslint src server shared && cd webview-ui && eslint .
scripts.lint:fix: eslint src server shared --fix && cd webview-ui && eslint . --fix
scripts.test: npm run test:webview && npm run test:server
scripts.build:opencode: tsup src/index.ts --format esm --dts --out-dir dist && cp dist/index.js dist/plugin.js
scripts.build:all: npm run build:opencode && npm run build:webview && npm run build:bridge
